training_holdout_split.method: Time-based split — train on activity before 2026-06-01, holdout after

feature_regime: Time-to-drain (balance withdrawal speed after inbound credit)
evaluation_protocol: Holdout accounts scored once at threshold_version thr-2026-08-01; no threshold re-tuning on holdout.
seed_sensitivity: Re-trained across 5 random seeds; Critical-band holdout precision varied 0.76-0.83.
calibration: Isotonic calibration applied to raw ensemble score to produce the display score shown in the queue and case screens.
leakage_exclusions: Post-decision account-status fields (closure, freeze flags) excluded from training features.
Any field populated only after a fraud case was opened on the account was excluded.
rejected_experiments: Device-fingerprint features rejected — supplied dataset had insufficient device coverage to validate signal.
Cross-account graph embeddings rejected for this version — training data does not contain real transaction edges.
limitations: Holdout precision at Critical (80.0%) is based on only 20 alerts — a small-sample estimate, not a stable long-run rate.
Graph and feed evidence shown in the product are simulated; the model itself was not trained on graph features.
No fairness/demographic-parity analysis has been run against protected attributes.
Model has not been evaluated against adversarial or intentionally evasive account behavior.
deployment_design: Local demo only. Model artifact and thresholds are loaded from a fixed local file at startup; no live retraining or feedback loop is implemented in this build.
